title: Tsarevets (fortress)
axis: Local +Z faces northeast toward the path inside the citadel, with X along the corresponding tower face.

nativeAxes.x: northwest parallel to the tower front

features.role: Individually named mapped footprint of Baldwin’s Tower inside the matching Tsarevets fortress site.

identityStatus: Native named tower Q4850503 and the contiguous surveyed curtain and path. The parent independently matches Tsarevets Q512147. Source terrain supplies the grade across the headland, and public-domain photography supplies the visible tower and wall forms.

terrainContact.basis: Unchanged Mapzen local ground on the landward approach. The exterior cliff below the tower is coarse in this field and is represented by the downward masonry foundation.

notes: The Regional Museum records the tower reuse of two periods of earlier foundations. The fortress describes the 1933 reconstruction by Alexander Rashenov. Kandi’s original shows the square cantilevered parapet, upper openings, external stair and low curtain extending along both sides of the ridge.
